mapper.select: select dc.nsrdzdah, dc.qyhgdm, dc.nsrmc, dc.nsrsbh, ds.swjg_mc as swjgDm, dc.tsjsfs_dm as tsjsfsDm, ck.kzxx as flgldj, dc.bsy1_mc as bsyMc, dc.bsy1_dh as bsyDh, dc.fddbrmc, dc.frdhhm, decode(ds.score, null, 0, ds.score) as scoreTotal from tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab dc inner join tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab_kz ck on dc.nsrdzdah=ck.nsrdzdah and ck.kzlx='FLGLCD' and ck.flag='1' left join tl_admin.yj_data_score ds on dc.nsrdzdah = ds.nsrdzdah inner join dm_swjg ds on dc.swjg_dm =ds.swjg_dm where dc.nsrsbh=#{nsrsbh} and rownum=1

select c.qyhgdm, c.nsrsbh, c.nsrmc, t.yjcode, y.yjname as yjcodeZh, t.zbcode, y.zbname as zbcodeZh, t.yj_msg as yjMsg, t.yj_object as yjObject, t.yj_count as yjCount, t.yj_amt as yjAmt, t.yj_tax as yjTax, t.yj_record as yjRecord, t.score, t.sbym, t.bmdflag, h.sbywb_dm as sbywbDm, h.sssq, h.sbpc, s.swjg_jc as swjgJc, t.cl_flag as clFlag, t.cl_date as clDate, t.cl_user as clUser, t.cl_msg as clMsg, t.bz, c.bsy1_mc as bsy1Mc, c.bsy2_mc as bsy2Mc, c.fddbrmc as fddbrmc from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx t, tl_admin.yj_sbxx_hz h, tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab c, tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzb y, tl_bjts.dm_swjg s where t.sbid = h.id(+) and t.nsrdzdah = h.nsrdzdah(+) and t.nsrdzdah = c.nsrdzdah and c.swjg_dm = s.swjg_dm and t.yjcode = y.yjcode and t.zbcode = y.zbcode and t.swflag='1'

select nvl(sum(t.yj_amt),0) as "yjAmt", nvl(sum(t.yj_tax),0) as "yjTax" from tl_admin.yj_data_yjxx t, tl_bjts.sb_sbxx_hz h, tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab c, tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzb y, tl_bjts.dm_swjg s where t.sbid = h.id(+) and t.nsrdzdah = h.nsrdzdah(+) and t.nsrdzdah = c.nsrdzdah and c.swjg_dm = s.swjg_dm and t.yjcode = y.yjcode and t.zbcode = y.zbcode and t.swflag='1'

select s.yjcode,s.yjname,s.yjinfo,s.zxflag,s.yjobject,s.yjlx,s.tsywlx, decode(t.qyflag,null,1,t.qyflag) as yxbz,s.swjg_fw as swjgFw from tl_admin.yj_DIC_CODE s left join tl_admin.yj_DIC_SWJG t on s.yjcode=t.yjcode
and t.swjgdm =#{swjgdm}
and substr(t.swjgdm,1,5)=substr(#{swjgdm},1,5)
where s.yxbz='Y' and
REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)(' || #{qxdm} || '|' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm},1,3) || '|' || #{qxdm} || '[0-9]{2}' || ')($|\|)' )
(REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || #{qxdm} || '($|\|)') OR REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 5) || '($|\|)') OR REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 3) || '($|\|)'))
s.swjg_fw like #{qxdm}||'%'
order by s.yjcode

select s.spdm,s.spmc,s.qnt,s.amt,s.dj,s.qyhs from tl_admin.yj_CS_QSPJDJ_WM s where 1=1
and s.SPDM like '%'||#{spdm}||'%'
and s.SPMC like '%'||#{spmc}||'%'
and s.DJ >= #{djq}
and #{djz} >=s.DJ

select sc.spdm,sc.spmc,sc.qnt,sc.amt,sc.dj,sc.qyhs from tl_admin.yj_CS_QSPJDJ_SC sc where 1=1
and sc.SPDM like '%'||#{spdm}||'%'
and sc.SPMC like '%'||#{spmc}||'%'
and sc.DJ >= #{djq}
and #{djz} >=sc.DJ

select t.syqy,t.zbcode,t.zbname,decode(t.jslx ,1 , '按报关单', 2, '按批次汇总', 3, '六个月汇总', t.jslx) as jslx, t.p1name, t.p1val as p1valchange, t.p2name, t.p2val as p2valchange, t.score as score, t.p3name, t.p3val as p3valchange, t.p4name, t.p4val as p4valchange, 'Y' as yxbz, '浙江省税务局' as swjgmc, '1' as showtype from tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzb t where t.yjcode = #{yjcode} and t.sysw='1' order by t.zbcode
mapper.delete: delete from tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzbswjg where swjgdm = #{swjgdm} and zbcode = #{zbcode}
mapper.select: select t.nsrdzdah from tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab t where t.qyhgdm=#{qybs} or t.shxyno=#{qybs} or t.nsrsbh=#{qybs}

select YJCODE,YJNAME,s.yjobject,s.yjlx from tl_admin.yj_DIC_CODE s where yxbz='Y' and sysw='1' and
REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)(' || #{qxdm} || '|' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm},1,3) || '|' || #{qxdm} || '[0-9]{2}' || ')($|\|)' )
(REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || #{qxdm} || '($|\|)') OR REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 5) || '($|\|)') OR REGEXP_LIKE(s.swjg_fw, '(^|\|)' || SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 3) || '($|\|)'))
s.swjg_fw like #{qxdm}||'%'
order by yjcode
select zbname, zbcode from tl_admin.yj_DIC_YJZB where yjcode=#{yjcode} and sysw='1' order by zbcode
select t.nsrmc from tl_bjts.gs_dj_cktmsdab t where t.qyhgdm=#{qybs} or t.shxyno=#{qybs} or t.nsrsbh=#{qybs}

select t.syqy,t.zbcode,t.zbname,decode(t.jslx ,1 , '按报关单', 2, '按批次汇总', 3, '六个月汇总', t.jslx) as jslx, t.p1name, nvl(s.p1val,t.p1val) as p1valchange, t.p2name, nvl(s.p2val,t.p2val) as p2valchange, t.p3name, nvl(s.p3val,t.p3val) as p3valchange, t.p4name, nvl(s.p4val,t.p4val) as p4valchange, nvl(s.score,t.score) as score, decode(s.yxbz, null, 'Y', s.yxbz) as yxbz, swjg.swjg_jc as swjgmc from tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzb t left join tl_admin.dm_swjg swjg on (swjg.swjg_dm= #{swjgDm}) left join tl_admin.yj_dic_yjzbswjg s on (t.zbcode = s.zbcode and s.swjgdm = swjg.swjg_dm_sj ) where t.yjcode = #{yjcode} and t.sysw='1'

SELECT hg.id, hg.hghyd_dm as hghydDm, hg.hghyd_mc as hghydMc, hg.xzqh_dm as xzqhDm, hg.xzqh_mc as xzqhMc, dm.qycode, dm.qyname FROM DM_HGHYD hg LEFT JOIN dm_xzqh dm ON dm.dm = hg.xzqh_dm WHERE 1=1
AND hg.hghyd_dm LIKE #{hghydDm} || '%'
AND hg.hghyd_mc LIKE '%' || #{hghydMc} || '%'
AND hg.xzqh_dm LIKE #{xzqhDm} || '%'
AND hg.xzqh_mc LIKE '%' || #{xzqhMc} || '%'
AND dm.qycode = #{qycode}
AND dm.qyname LIKE '%' || #{qyname} || '%'
ORDER BY hg.hghyd_dm

SELECT hg.HGCODE as hgcode, hg.HGMC as hgmc, hg.xzqh_dm as xzqhDm, hg.xzqh_mc as xzqhMc, dm.qycode, dm.qyname FROM DM_HGCODE hg LEFT JOIN dm_xzqh dm ON dm.dm = hg.xzqh_dm WHERE NVL(hg.qybz, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND hg.HGCODE LIKE #{hgcode} || '%'
AND hg.HGMC LIKE '%' || #{hgmc} || '%'
AND hg.xzqh_dm LIKE #{xzqhDm} || '%'
AND hg.xzqh_mc LIKE '%' || #{xzqhMc} || '%'
AND dm.qycode = #{qycode}
AND dm.qyname LIKE '%' || #{qyname} || '%'
ORDER BY hg.HGCODE

SELECT gb.gb_code as gbCode, gb.gb_name as gbName, gb.gb_ename as gbEname,qycode as gjqycode,qyname as gjqyname FROM DM_GBCODE gb WHERE NVL(gb.qybz, 'Y') = 'Y'
and gb_code<>qycode
AND gb.gb_code LIKE #{gbCode} || '%'
AND gb.gb_name LIKE '%' || #{gbName} || '%'
AND gb.qycode = #{gjqycode}
AND gb.qyname LIKE '%' || #{gjqyname} || '%'
AND gb.gb_ename LIKE '%' || #{gbEname} || '%'
ORDER BY gb.gb_code
select qycode as gjqycode, qyname as gjqyname from tl_admin.dm_gbcode where gb_code = qycode and qybz='Y' order by gb_code

SELECT t.FXDJ_DM as fxdjDm, t.FXDJ_MC as fxdjMc, t.FXDJ_PDBJ as fxdjPdbj, t.FXDJ_CZFS as fxdjCzfs, t.FXDJ_YZ as fxdjYz FROM CKLLFX_CS_FXDJSZ t WHERE 1=1
AND t.FXDJ_DM LIKE '%' || #{fxdjDm} || '%'
AND t.FXDJ_MC LIKE '%' || #{fxdjMc} || '%'
ORDER BY t.FXDJ_DM

SELECT t.SWJG_DM as swjgDm, s.swjg_mc as swjgMc, t.SBQYHS as sbqyhs, t.SBYWBS as sbywbs, t.MMYLRL_MIN as mmylllMin, t.MMYLRL_MAX as mmylllMax, t.MMYLRL_MID as mmylllMid, t.MMYLRL_AVG as mmylllAvg, t.MMYLRL_STD as mmylllStd, t.MMYLRL_YJX as mmylllYjx FROM TL_ADMIN.YJ_CS_WMQYMMYLRL t LEFT JOIN dm_swjg s ON s.swjg_dm = t.SWJG_DM WHERE 1=1
AND t.SWJG_DM LIKE #{qxdm} || '%'
AND (t.SWJG_DM = SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 3)||'00000000' OR t.SWJG_DM LIKE SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 5) || '%')
AND (t.SWJG_DM = SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 3)||'00000000' OR t.SWJG_DM = SUBSTR(#{qxdm}, 1, 5)||'000000' OR t.SWJG_DM LIKE #{qxdm} || '%')
ORDER BY t.SWJG_DM

select dm as xzqhDm,mc as xzqhMc,qycode,qyname from dm_xzqh t where dm<>qycode and qycode is not null and qybz = 'Y'
AND dm LIKE #{xzqhDm} || '%'
AND mc LIKE '%' || #{xzqhMc} || '%'
AND qycode = #{qycode}
AND qyname LIKE '%' || #{qyname} || '%'
order by dm
select qycode, qyname from tl_admin.dm_xzqh where dm = qycode and qybz = 'Y' order by dm
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TL_TSSH.CKLLFX_CS_SWJGYJTZ t USING (SELECT #{ysfsDm} AS ysfsDm, #{spdlDm} AS spdlDm, #{qycodeHyd} AS qycodeHyd, #{qycodeHg} AS qycodeHg, #{qycodeMdg} AS qycodeMdg, '2' AS tsjsffDm FROM dual) s ON (t.YSFS_DM = s.ysfsDm AND t.SPDL_DM = s.spdlDm AND t.QYCODE_HYD = s.qycodeHyd AND t.QYCODE_HG = s.qycodeHg AND t.QYCODE_MDG = s.qycodeMdg AND t.TSJSFF_DM = s.tsjsffDm AND t.SWJG_DM = #{swjgDm}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.FXDJ_TZ = #{fxdjTz}, t.FXDJ_TZRQ = SYSDATE, t.FXDJ_TZRY = #{fxdjTzry}, t.FXDJ_TZYY = #{fxdjTzYY} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SWJG_DM, TSJSFF_DM, YSFS_DM, SPDL_DM, QYCODE_HYD, QYCODE_HG, QYCODE_MDG, FXDJ_TZ, FXDJ_TZRQ, FXDJ_TZRY, FXDJ_TZYY) VALUES (#{swjgDm}, '2', #{ysfsDm}, #{spdlDm}, #{qycodeHyd}, #{qycodeHg}, #{qycodeMdg}, #{fxdjTz}, SYSDATE, #{fxdjTzry}, #{fxdjTzYY})
mapper.update: UPDATE TL_TSSH.CKLLFX_DATA_BGDWL SET CPH = #{cph, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CPYS_CODE = #{cpysCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CPYS_NAME = #{cpysName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, QYRQ = #{qyrq, jdbcType=DATE}, QYD = #{qyd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SJGXSJ = SYSDATE WHERE DJXH = #{djxh} AND BGDHGBH = #{bgdhgbh}
mapper.select: SELECT bg.BGDHGBH AS bgdhgbh, bg.CPH AS cph, bg.QYRQ AS qyrq, bg.QYD AS qydAddr, bg.CPYS_CODE AS cpysCode, NVL(dj.shxyno, dj.nsrdjno) AS nsrsbh, dj.nsrmc AS nsrmc, dj.swjgdm AS swjgdm, bg.CKRQ_1 AS ckrq, bg.MYLAJ AS mylaj, bg.SPDL_DM AS spDm, sp.cksp_mc AS spMc, bg.YSFS_DM AS ysfsDm, bg.HZDWDQ_DM AS hzdwdqDm, bg.HGGQKA_DM AS hggqkaDm, bg.JZXH AS jzxh, bg.ZZMDGDQSZ_DM AS zzmdgdqszDm, bg.TYDH AS tydh, bg.GHFNSRSBH_1 AS ghfnsrsbh, bg.GHFNSRMC AS ghfnsrmc, bg.GHFNSRSwjg AS ghfnsrswjg, bg.FHMS_DM AS fhmsDm FROM tl_tssh.glxt_bb_shxt_djxx dj INNER JOIN TL_TSSH.CKLLFX_DATA_BGDWL bg ON dj.djxh_js = bg.djxh LEFT JOIN TL_TSSH.jcfx_dm_cksptree sp ON sp.cksp_dm = bg.SPDL_DM WHERE bg.DJXH = #{djxh} AND bg.BGDHGBH = #{bgdhgbh} AND dj.swjgdm LIKE #{qxSwjgDm} || '%'
